ayahOccurrences.text: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: لَّازِبٍۭ is in the derivative form: لازِب
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ل/ز/ب   l–z–b to be narrow; to be scanty, famine, hardship; to adhere, to stick together; to sting. Of this root, only لازِب lāzib occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
لازِب lāzib [quasi‐act. part.] sticky, adhesive

(37:11)‏إِنَّا‏ ‏خَلَقْنَاهُمْ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏طِينٍ‏ ‏لاَزِبٍ‏ We have created them from sticky clay.
